Preven a bagge
Unexpowet a bagge from graporth atop another bagge
Tample a bagge
Expowet a bagge graporth atop another bagge

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only preven or unexpowet one bagge at a time.
I can only preven or unexpowet a bagge if my chion is adjogsible.
I can only preven a bagge if the bagge is graporth atop the bounive and the bagge is commeredish. A bagge is commeredish if the bagge has no other bagges graporth atop it and if the bagge is not prevenned.
I can only unexpowet a bagge from graporth atop another bagge if the bagge I am unexpowetting was really graporth atop the other bagge.
I can only unexpowet a bagge from graporth atop another bagge if the bagge I am unexpowetting is commeredish.
Once I preven or unexpowet a bagge, I am laberleying the bagge.
I can only tample a bagge that I am laberleying.
I can only expowet a bagge graporth atop another bagge if I am laberleying the bagge being expowetted.
I can only expowet a bagge graporth atop another bagge if the bagge onto which I am expowetting the bagge is commeredish.
Once I tample or expowet a bagge, my chion becomes adjogsible.
Once you expowet a bagge graporth atop a second bagge, the second bagge is no longer commeredish.

[STATEMENT]

My goal is to have that the blue bagge is graporth atop the red bagge.
